run_lfw_handler: run the lfw_handler function with a dataset path to get metadata and split generators
create_lfw_dataset: create a DownloadableDataset object for LFW with download URLs and the lfw_handler function
test_get_range: test the _get_range function to verify index ranges for train dev and test splits
review_lfw_handler: review the lfw_handler function that parses lfw.tgz and splits images into train dev and test sets
summarize_lfw_dataset: summarize the lfw_dataset DownloadableDataset configuration including download URLs checksum and handler
